data.title: 中野四叶 · 碧海晴空的踏浪水仗
data.description: 晴空万里的白沙滩边，碧蓝的海浪拍打着浅滩。四叶身穿薄荷绿运动比基尼，欢笑着弯腰捧起大捧清凉晶莹的海水泼向镜头。阳光将飞溅的水珠照耀得如同钻石般闪亮，她的笑容比夏日的烈阳还要纯净耀眼。
data.action: splashing water at camera, splashing waves, joyful laughter
data.lighting: dazzling midday sun, shimmering water reflections
data.promptProse: Splashing sparkling ocean water toward the viewer on a sunny tropical beach, Nakano Yotsuba beams with pure joy. She wears a mint-green sporty bikini with white piping, her green rabbit ribbon catching the sea breeze amid crystal droplets.
data.animaCaption: Yotsuba playfully splashing water on a sunny beach in a green bikini.
